item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Something decidedly non-euclidian is attempting to push from a place where physics and basic concepts of reality may be a bad joke, in to here. What's more, it's being smooshed in to odd extensions, and trying to communicate and deal with an alien concept of "hunger"…this thing may actually be going insane. So…it might be both, always and sometimes.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Very interesting. Another old SCP that I don't recall having seen anything written about. One quibble:

We project, in odd patters, sometimes strange, sometimes nightmarish, sometimes entrapping. Always strange.

Sometimes strange, or always? Can't be both. Also patterns.
